# Longitudinal association between CRP levels and risk of psychosis: a meta-analysis of population-based cohort studies

Here you can find the data and code reproducing the analyses presented in the paper:

Longitudinal association between CRP levels and risk of psychosis: a meta-analysis of population-based cohort studies. *npj Schizophrenia, accepted in principle, 2021*

On Code Ocean, pressing Reproducible Run will execute the R analyses and generate:
 *   the meta-analyses output
 *   all figures presented in the paper (in the results section)

library(readr)
library(metafor)

#run each analysis non adjusted, and adjusted at 2 stages of confounds

## less 3 more 3 ORs
for (i in c("OR","OR_AgeSexBmi","OR_multiadj","OR_nohi","OR_AgeSexBmi_nohi", "OR_multiadj_nohi")){
        d <- read_csv("/data/less3more3.csv")
        head(d)
        
        LCI <- paste0(i,"_LCI")
        UCI <- paste0(i,"_UCI")
        
        
        d$logor<-log(d[[i]]) 
        d$se1<-(log(d[[UCI]])-d$logor)/1.96
        d$se2<-(d$logor-log(d[[LCI]]))/1.96
        d$se<-(d$se1+d$se2)/2
        d$age_baseline<-d$age_psychiatric_outcome-d$dist_yrs_average
        
        #table(d$CRP_categories)
        table(d$age_baseline)
        print(i)
        dmres<-rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, 
                        data=d, method = "REML",
                        slab = Authoryear)
        print(summary(dmres))
        print(regtest(dmres))
        #funnel(dmres)
        weights(dmres)
        subtitle<-ifelse(test = i=="OR",yes = "",no = 
                       ifelse(test = i=="OR_AgeSexBmi",yes = "Adjusted for age, sex and BMI*",no = 
                                      ifelse(test = i=="OR_multiadj",yes = "Adjusted for age, sex, BMI, \nsmoking, alcohol consumption, socioeconomic status*",no = 
                                                     ifelse(test = i=="OR_nohi",yes = "After excluding subjects with CRP >10mg/L at baseline",no = 
                                                                    ifelse(test = i=="OR_AgeSexBmi_nohi",yes = "After excluding subjects with CRP >10mg/L at baseline\nAdjusted for age, sex and BMI",no = 
                                                                                   "After excluding subjects with CRP >10mg/L at baseline\nAdjusted for age, sex, BMI,\nsmoking, alcohol consumption, socioeconomic status*")))))
        
        N_pop<-ifelse(rep(grepl(pattern = "nohi",i),length(d$N)),format(d$N_nohi,big.mark=","),format(d$N,big.mark=","))
        N_cases<-ifelse(rep(grepl(pattern = "nohi",i),length(d$`N-outcome`)),format(d$N_outcomes_nohi,big.mark=","),format(d$`N-outcome`,big.mark=","))
        
        ##FOREST PLOT
        png(filename = paste0("/results/",i,"_less3more3_",Sys.Date(),".png"), width = 1800, height = 900, res = 180)#, overwrite = T)
        forest(dmres, atransf=exp, 
               xlim=c(-2.5,5.6), at = log(c(0.3,1,2.7,7)),
               ylim=c(-1, 12),rows=c(8,7,3,2),cex=1, 
               ilab=cbind(N_cases, N_pop, d$age_psychiatric_outcome), ilab.xpos=c(2.4,2.95,3.5),showweights=T,
               xlab="Meta-analytic Odds Ratio", mlab="",  header=FALSE,#"Author(s) and Year",
               main=NULL)
        ### set font expansion factor (as in forest() above) and use bold italic
        ### font and save original settings in object 'op'
        op <- par()
        par(cex=0.85, font=4)
        ### add text for the subgroups
        text(-2.4, c(4,9), pos=4, c("CRP measured in childhood/adolescence",
                                    "CRP mea

        text(c(0.6,0.78,0.96,1.15), 11, c("N\npsychosis","N\nsample","age at\noutcome","study\nweight"))
        
        
        ### fit random-effects model in the three subgroups
        res.O <- rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, subset=(age=="O"), data=d, method = "REML", slab = Authoryear)
        res.E <- rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, subset=(age=="E"), data=d, method = "REML",slab = Authoryear)

}









## multi level (<1, 1-3, >3)
for (i in c("OR","OR_AgeSexBmi","OR_multiadj","OR_nohi","OR_AgeSexBmi_nohi", "OR_multiadj_nohi")){
        
        d <- readr::read_csv("/data/multi-level.csv")
        head(d)
        
        #table(d$CRP_categories)
        d$CRP_categories<-factor(d$CRP_categories, levels = c("1--3", ">3") )
        levels(d$CRP_categories)<- c("1-3", ">3")
        
        LCI <- paste0(i,"_LCI")
        UCI <- paste0(i,"_UCI")
        
        
        d$logor<-log(d[[i]]) 
        d$se1<-(log(d[[UCI]])-d$logor)/1.96
        d$se2<-(d$logor-log(d[[LCI]]))/1.96
        d$se<-(d$se1+d$se2)/2
        
        
        
        
        
        (dmres<-rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, #weights = c(1,1,1,1),#weights = c(50,50,100,100),

                        slab = Authoryear)) #, mods = ~ factor(CRP_categories)
        
        
        weights(dmres)
        print(summary(dmres))
        subtitle<-ifelse(test = i=="OR",yes = "",no =

                                                ifelse(test = i=="OR_multiadj",yes = "Adjusted for age, sex, BMI, \nsmoking, alcohol consumption, socioeconomic status*",no =

                                                                                             "After excluding subjects with CRP >10mg/L at baseline\nAdjusted for age, sex, BMI, smoking, alcohol consumption, socioeconomic status*")))))
        N_pop<-ifelse(rep(grepl(pattern = "nohi",i),length(d$N)),d$N_nohi,d$N)
        N_cases<-ifelse(rep(grepl(pattern = "nohi",i),length(d$`N-outcome`)),d$N_outcomes_nohi,d$`N-outcome`)
        
        
        png(filename = paste0("/results/",i,"_multilevel_",Sys.Date(),".png"), width = 2000, height = 1300, res = 160)
        
        forest(dmres, atransf=exp,
               rows=c(12:9, 5:2),ylim=c(-1, 16),
               xlim=c(-2.5,4.6), at = log(c(0.3,1,2.7,7)),
               ilab=cbind(N_pop, d$age_psychiatric_outcome), ilab.xpos=c(2.8,3.4),#showweights=T,
               xlab="Meta-analytic Odds Ratio", mlab="", header=FALSE,
               
               )
        op <- par()
        ### add text for the subgroups
        par(font=3, cex=1.1)
        text(-2.2, c(13,6), pos=4, c(#"CRP <1 mg/L (reference)",
                                      "CRP >1 and ≤3 mg/L",
                                      "CRP >3 mg/L"))
        
        par(cex=1.2, font=2)
        text(0,15.5, paste0(#"Meta analysis of ORs for psychosis for categorical CRP\nReference: CRP <1mg/L\n",
                           subtitle))
        par(cex=1, font=1)
        text(c(2.8,3.4), 15, c("N\nsample","age at\noutcome"))
        ### fit random-effects model in the three subgroups
        # res.1 <- rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, #weights = N,#weights = c(50,50,100,100),
        #                  data=d, subset=(CRP_categories=="<=1"),
        #                  slab = Authoryear )
        res.13 <- rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, method = "REML",
                          data=d, subset=(CRP_categories=="1-3"),
                          slab = Authoryear )
        res.3 <- rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, method = "REML",
                         data=d, subset=(CRP_categories==">3"),
                         slab = Authoryear )
          
        ### add summary polygons for the three subgroups
        par(cex=0.75, font=4)
        #addpoly(res.1, row=13, cex=1.25, atransf=exp, mlab="RE model for CRP <1")
        addpoly(res.13, row= 7.7, cex=1.25,  atransf=exp, mlab="RE model for CRP 1-3")
        addpoly(res.3, row= 0.7, cex=1.25,  atransf=exp, mlab="RE model for CRP >3")
        par(op)
        dev.off()
        
}

library(readr)
library(metafor)

#run each analysis non adjusted, and adjusted at 2 stages of confounds

## less 3 more 3 ORs
for (i in c("OR","OR_AgeSexBmi","OR_multiadj","OR_nohi","OR_AgeSexBmi_nohi", "OR_multiadj_nohi")){
        d <- read_csv("/data/less3more3.csv")
        head(d)
        
        LCI <- paste0(i,"_LCI")
        UCI <- paste0(i,"_UCI")
        
        
        d$logor<-log(d[[i]]) 
        d$se1<-(log(d[[UCI]])-d$logor)/1.96
        d$se2<-(d$logor-log(d[[LCI]]))/1.96
        d$se<-(d$se1+d$se2)/2
        d$age_baseline<-d$age_psychiatric_outcome-d$dist_yrs_average
        
        #table(d$CRP_categories)
        table(d$age_baseline)
        print(i)
        dmres<-rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, 
                        data=d, method = "REML",
                        slab = Authoryear)
        print(summary(dmres))
        print(regtest(dmres))
        #funnel(dmres)
        weights(dmres)
        subtitle<-ifelse(test = i=="OR",yes = "",no = 
                       ifelse(test = i=="OR_AgeSexBmi",yes = "Adjusted for age, sex and BMI*",no = 
                                      ifelse(test = i=="OR_multiadj",yes = "Adjusted for age, sex, BMI, \nsmoking, alcohol consumption, socioeconomic status*",no = 
                                                     ifelse(test = i=="OR_nohi",yes = "After excluding subjects with CRP >10mg/L at baseline",no = 
                                                                    ifelse(test = i=="OR_AgeSexBmi_nohi",yes = "After excluding subjects with CRP >10mg/L at baseline\nAdjusted for age, sex and BMI",no = 
                                                                                   "After excluding subjects with CRP >10mg/L at baseline\nAdjusted for age, sex, BMI,\nsmoking, alcohol consumption, socioeconomic status*")))))
        
        N_pop<-ifelse(rep(grepl(pattern = "nohi",i),length(d$N)),format(d$N_nohi,big.mark=","),format(d$N,big.mark=","))
        N_cases<-ifelse(rep(grepl(pattern = "nohi",i),length(d$`N-outcome`)),format(d$N_outcomes_nohi,big.mark=","),format(d$`N-outcome`,big.mark=","))
        
        ##FOREST PLOT
        png(filename = paste0("/results/",i,"_less3more3_",Sys.Date(),".png"), width = 1800, height = 900, res = 180)#, overwrite = T)
        forest(dmres, atransf=exp, 
               xlim=c(-2.5,5.6), at = log(c(0.3,1,2.7,7)),
               ylim=c(-1, 12),rows=c(8,7,3,2),cex=1, 
               ilab=cbind(N_cases, N_pop, d$age_psychiatric_outcome), ilab.xpos=c(2.4,2.95,3.5),showweights=T,
               xlab="Meta-analytic Odds Ratio", mlab="",  header=FALSE,#"Author(s) and Year",
               main=NULL)
        ### set font expansion factor (as in forest() above) and use bold italic
        ### font and save original settings in object 'op'
        op <- par()
        par(cex=0.85, font=4)
        ### add text for the subgroups
        text(-2.4, c(4,9), pos=4, c("CRP measured in childhood/adolescence",
                                    "CRP measured in adulthood/old age"))
        ### switch to bold font
        par(font=2)
        ## add text for plot title and subtitle
        text(0,11.5, paste0(#"Meta analysis of ORs for psychosis of CRP >3 vs ≤3 mg/L\n",
                         subtitle))
        text(c(2.4,2.95,3.5,4.1), 11, c("N\npsychosis","N\nsample","age at\noutcome","study\nweight"))
        
       
        
        ### fit random-effects model in the three subgroups
        res.O <- rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, subset=(age=="O"), data=d, method = "REML", slab = Authoryear)
        res.E <- rma.uni(yi=logor, sei=se, subset=(age=="E"), data=d, method = "REML",slab = Authoryear)
        
        ### add summary polygons for the three subgroups
        addpoly(res.E, row=1, cex=1, atransf=exp, mlab="")
        addpoly(res.O, row= 6, cex=1, atransf=exp, mlab="")
        
        
        ### add text for subgroups
        text(-2.4, 1, pos=4, cex=1, bquote("RE Model for Subgroup"))
        text(-2.4, 6, pos=4, cex=1, bquote("RE Model for Subgroup"))
        
        dev.off()
        par(op)
}
